quote: The DialogSum Challenge asks a model to generate a salient, concise, fluent, and coherent summary, given a piece of multi-turn dialogue text.

guideline: Human annotators evaluate system-generated summaries on multiple aspects: Standard Summarization Metrics (Fluency, Consistency, Relevance and Coherence), Coreference Information, Intent Identification, Discourse Relation, Objective Description, and an Overview Score.
Annotators answer questions/criteria covering fluency, consistency, relevance, coherence, coreference, intent, discourse relation, objective description, and overall overview score.
Human annotators will follow Kryscinski et al. ( )'s criteria, and evaluate on a 50 randomly selected sub-testset.
